sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hello,

Hi, thanks for the email; the volume and your promise to pay on time is great news for us. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Since these penalties add risk for us, the best price we can do with them is 47.50 EUR. 

Our offer is a price of €48.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: a price of €47.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 2500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. But honestly, that volume bump alone isn't enough for us to drop the price any further. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

You say you'll pay on the due date, but we really need shorter payment terms officially to help us out if you want a better price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Also, a binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €47.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

We really hope these terms work for you and look forward to getting started!

Marek Lis
